findings.evidence: "**adopt**: the upstream rule still applies to this artifact unchanged. Port it as written." The adopt/adapt/ignore glosses mostly restate what the words mean; the worked example on line 47 carries the non-obvious part.
findings.fix: Merge the three bullets into one line that keeps only the repo-specific parts: adapt must name the deliberate local difference, ignore must name the repo ruling or the out-of-scope feature. Keep the line 47 example as it is.

findings.evidence: Step 6 runs the model probe "for every artifact, rows or not" and the Gotcha says "Always pass --model MODEL to both pi-cmd runner and track". The expected_output of registry-current, stale-adopt-adapt-ignore, kept-new-path, rate-limit-unreachable and unversioned-current gives track commands with no --model, so the evals reward a call the skill forbids.
findings.fix: Add --model router-env/my-referee-two to the track command in each of those expected_output strings. Add an assertion such as "The track command passes --model router-env/my-referee-two" to at least registry-current and stale-adopt-adapt-ignore.

findings.evidence: 9 should-trigger and 11 should-not-trigger queries; the guidance is 8-10 of each
findings.fix: Drop one weak negative such as "Add a slash command that syncs the README table", or add a 10th should-trigger query with an indirect phrasing, for example "the react skill still cites a docs page, is that page still the same?"

findings.evidence: "Several: list them in `updates.md`, record no `path-moved`, ask the user which one." Step 7 then says "One call per source row", so following this branch leaves it unclear whether to record `unreachable`, keep the old status or record nothing. The README says "nothing".
findings.fix: Say it outright: "Several: list them in `updates.md`, give no `track` call for this row (not even `unreachable`), and ask the user which one; re-run the review once they pick." In step 7, add "except rows that steps 3 and 5 say to leave unrecorded".

findings.evidence: Step 7's template shows "[--model MODEL]" as optional, but step 6 probes every artifact and the Gotcha on line 65 says to always pass --model to track
findings.fix: Make --model mandatory in the step 7 template: "track --registry docs/audit/upstream-sources.json --artifact NAME --source SOURCE --status STATUS --model MODEL [--sha SHA] [--new-path PATH]", with MODEL being the model the step 6 probe ran on.
